messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: HIGH - queue.backlog > 10000 for service ‘inference-hotpath’ (policy=queue-surge). PD: https://pd.example/INC12345

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 created and routed to @Kai (on-call). Trigger: sustained queue > threshold for 6m. Escalation in 5m if unacknowledged.

Kai (on-call): ack. I'm on it.

Maya (SRE): Looking at the autoscaler dashboard — target pods increased but nodepool isn't provisioning new nodes. Pending pods stuck in ContainerCreating, reason: "AttachVolume: multi-attach error" on CSI detach.

Arjun: Oof, we've seen CSI detachment races cause scale stalls before. Which nodes?

Kai (on-call): nodepool-prod-gpu-12 and nodepool-prod-gpu-13 show pods in Terminating for >4m, kubelet logs pile up with attach/detach timeouts.

Nora (eng-runtime): That aligns with the recent EBS driver upgrade from last week. Could be a regression. Do we have cluster-level drain hooks preventing new nodes?

Maya (SRE): Running quick kubectl: 
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep Pending
```
output: 
```
inference-req-xxxx Pending 0/1 ContainerCreating nodepool-prod-gpu-12
inference-req-yyyy Pending 0/1 ContainerCreating nodepool-prod-gpu-13
```

Sam (support): Customer impact: support queue shows 12 active customer requests experiencing timeouts (timeouts ~30s). Triage: impact limited to realtime endpoints; offline jobs unaffected.

Kai (on-call): Action plan: (1) attempt to forcibly detach stuck volumes, (2) if that fails, manually cordon + drain the problematic nodes to allow autoscaler to provision replacements, (3) open PD incident and update customers. Anyone disagree?

Maya (SRE): Agree. I'll try graceful detach first. Command I'll run: 
```
aws ec2 detach-volume --volume-id vol-0abcd1234 --force
```

Arjun: Watch for data corruption. Use force only if we confirm pod is not writing. Which volumes? Maya, paste list?

Maya (SRE): Pulling PVC -> PV mapping now. 
```
kubectl get pvc -n inference -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{" -> "}{.spec.volumeName}{"\n"}{end}'
```
Mapping: inference-pvc-req-xxxx -> pvc-pv-01 (vol-0abcd1234)

Kai (on-call): Maya, proceed with detach on vol-0abcd1234 if you're confident. I'll notify PD and escalate if we hit the 5m ack window.

pagerduty: INC12345 updated: acknowledged by Kai. Escalation paused.

Maya (SRE): Forced detach succeeded for vol-0abcd1234. Pod for inference-req-xxxx moved to ContainerCreating -> Running. Queue dipped a bit.

Nora (eng-runtime): Noticed significant KV cache warmup delay on new pods. That explains residual latency. We should mark a short warmup window to avoid errors. Pushing a flag to disable heavy cache loads for new replicas.

Arjun: Still two pods in Terminating on nodepool-prod-gpu-13; kubelet hostname shows detach loops. I'm going to cordon + drain node to get autoscaler to replace. 

Kai (on-call): Runbook step: cordon -> drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data. Post the exact commands when you run them.

Arjun: Running now: 
```
kubectl cordon nodepool-prod-gpu-13
kubectl drain nodepool-prod-gpu-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

Arjun: Drain completed, 3 pods evicted. Autoscaler signalled and new nodes provisioning. 

Maya (SRE): I'm watching cluster-autoscaler logs: scale-up event triggered, requested 2 nodes, provider accepted. ETA ~2.5m.

Sam (support): Notifying affected customers: "We're seeing a temporary capacity event impacting realtime responses; we're mitigating and expect recovery within ~10 minutes. We'll update if anything changes."

Nora (eng-runtime): Deployed a temporary warmup-skip flag via feature switch: inference.hotpath.skip_warmup=true for new replicas. Should reduce initial tail latency.

Kai (on-call): Good call. Monitor latency and queue. If backlog remains >5k after nodes come up, consider routing lower-priority traffic to a degraded model variant to protect SLAs.

Maya (SRE): New nodes joined at 1768460250. Pods are scheduling, KV cache rehydrates. Queue dropped from 11,200 -> 2,100 over ~3m. Latency 95p dropped from 420ms -> 120ms.

pagerduty: INC12345: note added by Kai: Capacity event due to CSI detach failures causing autoscaler stall; manual detaches + node drain initiated; new nodes provisioned. Recommend RCA.

Kai (on-call): Marking incident as mitigated. Leaving PD incident open for RCA + postmortem. I'll hand over to Maya for RCA and Nora for runtime changes follow-up.

Maya (SRE): I'll open an RCA ticket and include logs, EBS driver version, and steps we took. Tentative root cause: regression in CSI detach after upgrade; follow-up: pin driver version and add a pre-upgrade smoke test.

Nora (eng-runtime): I'll track the warmup flag rollback and add an autoscaler healthcheck that fails fast if nodes remain in Terminating >2m.

Sam (support): Updating customers: "Issue mitigated. Full service restored. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem." :white_check_mark:

Kai (on-call): Thanks team. Adding final notes to the incident channel and assigning owners: Maya -> RCA, Nora -> infra mitigations, Arjun -> infra cleanups. Closing thread here.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status changed: mitigated. Link: https://pd.example/INC12345
